blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and older. Never give it to children under 15.
• This product contains small parts. Keep it away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a choking hazard.
• This product has pointed and sharp parts. Handle and store it carefully. Unexpected injury may occur.

• Dispose of plastic packaging immediately after opening.
• This product has painted surfaces. When storing it, avoid contact with other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as the color may transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts in unnatural directions.
